TC-21/S22.title: iOS simulator build on the local stack, and a phone with a wrong clock
TC-21/S22.detail: Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Android half, phone 2 days ahead in Pacific/Kiritimati (the app asked for a new sign-in after the clock change and got in through its form) vs the desktop on the real clock. Judged (TFA-92584): 2/5 - badge differs in both contexts (phone Follow-up vs desktop New Admission / Consult) and the Hospital pre-selected template differs (SOAP progress vs H&P); the Nursing Home template matches (SNF follow-up on both). Known B18 / TFA-92584 AC 8. Worse than a display difference: the phone's day rule wrote the rows back with its own future day (stored encType follow-up, encTypeDay 2026-10-17 for the patient and the resident; the resident's visit date 'Sat Oct 17 2026', U20 gated TFA-94699), so every device now shows Follow-up. The timeline line the phone wrote is dated with the real day ('Visit 1 – Oct 15: Pre-rounded.', TFA-92589) on both. Todo (TFA-92599 in progress, recorded): the context chosen last (Nursing Home) comes back after 8 s in the background and after closing and reopening; template lists match the web; no Clinic anywhere. Hospital day / visit number not shown on main (B23). iOS half not run: the simulator cannot be tapped here without a permission prompt (no idb / Maestro / WebDriverAgent installed; the simulator-control and computer-use tools ask first), and the only booted simulator runs someone else's dev-pointed build (b8fb762), which was left alone. A separate prompt-free smoke on a new simulator (dvc-tc24-s24-ios-*) showed the iOS build on the local stack opening and listing patients.
TC-21/S22.productIssue: A phone whose clock is two days ahead shows Follow-up for a patient set to New Admission today (and pre-selects the follow-up template), and by opening the chart it rewrites the stored status to Follow-up dated two days ahead, so every device loses the New Admission (known B18 / TFA-92584 AC 8).
